about: The Workbench icons of the ZeroZeroUFO drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/ports/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art (art/zeroufo.png) is the player's UFO (UFO_0 in ufo.dat, 16 x 11, on EGA_PAL, written by tests/host/test_data with ZU_ICON) scaled 8 times, MIT like the game. ZeroZeroUFO-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, ZeroZeroUFO.info beside the drawer. ReadMe.info is also copied for ReadMe-ZeroZeroUFO, LICENSE.txt, Controls and Licences.txt; Data.info is the User drawer's icon.
